islands.law:
# The atlas's value wave, as a law of nature. Transcribed from Atlas._wave:
#
#     V = max(source, best neighbour * (1 - decay)^distance) * passable
#
# with decay 0.06 (0.94 per orthogonal step, 0.94^sqrt2 = 0.916214 per diagonal)
# and a solid cell letting `leak` of the wave through — the harness's per-cell
# leak, innate then taught per hue by what pressing on it did.
# max8 also contains the four orthogonal neighbours, but they are discounted
# more there than under max4, so the max of the two is exactly the eight-way
# wave with a diagonal that costs sqrt 2. The harness paints source and solid
# each thought, steps this `subticks` times, and reads value at the centre.

channel source
channel solid
channel value

rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(source, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
# Confinement suppression (night lab 2026-09-23, champion #35): a source hemmed in by
# solid counts less, so local food in a nook stops dominating and the frontier wins there.
# 24.5 meals on 32 never-seen FINAL worlds vs 18.8 the reference wave, 17.1 the tuned ghost.

channel source
channel solid
channel free
channel thing
channel here
channel value
channel confinement
channel injection

# Measure local solidity to detect dead-ends/corridors.
# High sum8(solid) means tight space.
rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# Inject signals, but suppress heavily if in a tight space.
# The division by (1 + k*conf) reduces value in dead-ends.
# This prevents the agent from being pulled into local maxima in confined areas.
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = max(thing, source) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Propagate the value wave.
# Use standard Bellman decay. The suppressed injection ensures dead-ends don't dominate.
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
# Sources linger: a commitment law. The smell of a thing behind a wall is
# painted where the world's geodesic bearing points, and that bearing flips
# between the two ways round as the agent takes a step each way (seen on world
# 7: eleven frames out of twelve on the same spot, the source hopping left and
# right of it). Here a painted source keeps ~94% of itself per thought after
# the paint moves on, so the wave still holds the place it was first told and
# the nearer of the two stays the target. Where the agent stands there is
# nothing: `here` and its ring erase the ghost (an eaten morsel leaves no
# ghost to circle).

channel source
channel solid
channel here
channel value
channel ghost: init 0

rule linger:
  when 1
  set ghost = max(source, 0.99 * ghost) * (1 - here) * (1 - max8(here))

rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(ghost, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak))

islands.law:
# Inhibition of return: a decaying trail of where the agent has stood suppresses
# re-injection there, so smell traps and two-way limit cycles burn themselves out.

channel source
channel solid
channel thing
channel here
channel bad
channel value
channel trail
channel confinement
channel injection

# Trail of visited cells (centre + a faint ring), slow fade, bounded in [0, 1].
rule walk:
  when 1
  set trail = max(here, 0.6 * max8(here), 0.997 * trail)

# Local solidity: dead-ends and nooks.
rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# Seen morsels inject fully; other sources fade where the agent already went.
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = max(thing, source * (1 - 0.8 * trail)) * (1 - bad) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Bellman wave; remembered poison blocks passage like solid.
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak)) * (1 - 0.9 * bad)

islands.hypothesis: Add inhibition of return. A slowly fading TRAIL channel marks the cells the agent has stood on, and it scrolls with the map. Smell and frontier sources are injected weaker on that trail, while seen morsels still inject at full strength. A smell bearing that flips between two ways round a wall, or a nook already searched, stops pulling the agent back, so the wave turns to unvisited frontier instead of a limit cycle. The 0-meal worlds look like this kind of trap. Remembered poison (`bad`) also damps the wave, so the agent does not walk back over a burn.

islands.law:
# Information-gain frontier + remembered morsels, on top of inhibition of return.

channel source
channel solid
channel free
channel thing
channel scent
channel here
channel bad
channel value
channel trail
channel confinement
channel dark
channel ghost
channel injection

# Trail of visited cells, slow fade, bounded in [0, 1].
rule walk:
  when 1
  set trail = max(here, 0.6 * max8(here), 0.997 * trail)

# Local solidity: dead-ends and nooks.
rule calc_conf:
  when 1
  set confinement = sum8(solid)

# Smoothed unknown mass: how much unexplored map lies around a cell, in [0, 1].
rule calc_dark:
  when 1
  set dark = 0.5 * (1 - max(solid, free)) + 0.5 * avg8(dark)

# Seen morsels are remembered after they leave sight; erased where the agent stands or got burned.
rule remember:
  when 1
  set ghost = max(thing, 0.998 * ghost) * (1 - here) * (1 - bad)

# Frontier marks (no scent, no thing) are weighted by the darkness behind them; trail inhibits re-injection.
rule inject:
  when 1
  set injection = max(0.8 * ghost, thing, where(scent + thing > 0.01, source, source * (0.4 + 1.6 * dark)) * (0.7387 - 0.7824 * trail)) * (1.029 - bad) / (1 + 0.5 * confinement)

# Bellman wave; remembered poison blocks passage like solid.
rule wave:
  when 1
  set value = max(injection, max(0.94 * max4(value), 0.916214 * max8(value))) * (1 - solid * (1 - leak)) * (1 - 0.9 * bad)
